post.title: Ofgem's January 2027 energy price cap: what it means for household energy bills
post.description: Ofgem's cap for January to March 2027 is {{jan_total:gbp}} a year for a household with typical consumption, a change of {{jan_change_pct:spct1}} from the October to December cap. PolicyEngine estimates it changes average household energy spending in Great Britain by {{mean_change:sgbp}} a year, holding energy use fixed.
